name: Dense Forest
descriptions: Ancient trees crowd so closely that their trunks form a wall of bark. Little light reaches the ground, and the air is still and damp.
Thorny undergrowth snags at you from every side. You push through brambles between towering, moss-draped trunks.
Gnarled roots heave up from the dark soil like the backs of sleeping beasts. The silence here is heavy.
Strands of grey lichen hang from low branches. Somewhere in the gloom, a twig snaps.
The canopy is so thick that it feels like dusk. Pale mushrooms ring the base of a vast, hollow tree.
A tangle of fallen limbs and creepers makes every step uncertain. The smell of rot and wet earth is strong.
Huge trunks, too wide to embrace, rise into darkness. Their bark is scored with old claw marks.

lines: Something moves in the undergrowth, then is still.
Water drips steadily from the leaves.
